title: Predicting economic activity using atmospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) satellite data: Evidence from local economic indicators in Japan

idea.research_question: Can satellite atmospheric NO2 provide a timely regional economic-activity proxy where nighttime lights saturate or miss daytime production?
idea.hypothesis: NO2 responds to combustion-related production and transport, complementing or outperforming nighttime lights for selected sectors and time scales.
idea.mechanism: Two-way fixed-effects panel regression, sector comparison and cross-proxy validation
idea.expected_contribution: Transfers an atmospheric-composition observable into socioeconomic measurement.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if any required role is omitted, background-only, or not operationally used in the same research instance.

anchor_context.extraction_basis: Full-text seed evidence; empirical results are excluded from the task prompt.
